title: Beth NDE 1023
content:
I was in bad pain, at ten on their scales. I asked God to take the pain away. Then I was suddenly above looking down on my monitor and IV pole and my body. I then saw a white being that floated up. I was asked if I was ready and I said yes. Then the being told me to follow. I followed and went to see my kids. I kept arguing that I could go and it would be okay for them. I went to the waiting room and saw my family. They were talking and I watched them. I saw my son on the playground at school. I then went to the light to see my mother who had passed. I could not go in. I would have to make a decision. I wanted to go, but the being showed me what would happen to my children if I did. It was bad. So, basically I gave in and said okay. Then I went back to my body and watched myself go back in. Then the nurse grabbed my hand and said I was okay. There were things in between, but too painful to discuss at this time. Weird part was that I watched this nurse take a coke break at the beginning of the experience and the nurse across the room chewed her out on her return because I had gone into respiratory arrest. The monitor flat-lined, but the hospital has little record of this, except that my records show that while the nurse was gone, my rates were exactly the same while she was gone. She made them up. Several nurses later verified this, against the hospital's wishes.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related Had cancer, hysterectomy, left a bleeder Hospital never admitted death. Records show otherwise, by nurse on duty.I was in pain, didn't know why. They kept giving me morphine to subside pain. Angel told me it was the ' bleeder' the doctor left in me. It would be healed.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Special Knowledge | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes Really, more when I went back in. It was like the movie Ghost, where I watched my spirit hand go into my body hand.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Very alert, although I couldn't figure out at first why I was above the IV pole.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Just the flying to see the kids. It was very fast.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: No I saw it, but could not pass, that was the decision making moment. I had a choice.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw people standing around the light, but not smiling, just standing. I had a feeling they knew me and loved me, but I did not recognize anyone.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I saw my child on his playground and verified this later with him playing football with a certain child and then I told the daycare worker what my daughter had for lunch. Spaghetti. It was true.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I knew why I had died, and that God knew I had tried to commit suicide many years before.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control The only detail was that I had tried to commit suicide in high school. It was said to me, 'You tried to kill yourself once, now you are making your choice, don't threaten to do it again. You are choosing to live for your children. No more. You are to live.'
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I knew that my children would be in danger, although nothing had happened so far. I later found out, after I came back, that my daughter had been molested by her stepbrother. I had to fight for her. Then, my ex-husband entered a drug rehabilitation center, which would have left my children to I don't know what.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I decided to come back. I should never try to commit suicide again. That was my chance to go and I decided to stay.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I now am not scared to die. It doesn't hurt.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I told my family I heard what they said in the waiting room - word for word.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I didn't want to come back, just thought I needed to.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They think I am nuts. Even after I quoted their conversations in the waiting room - now they sort of believe me.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I have nothing more to say and have told you more than I have told anyone. Do not contact me.
